text:
olivia: @channel Quick heads-up: Hosted Gen API v3 is GA. Streaming + tool-calling are production-ready and a new low-latency variant redwood-mosaic-latency-1 is live. Were deprecating /v2 gen endpoints in 90 days. :tada:

kevin: Rollout plan: canary 2% -> 20% -> 100% over ~3h with health gates. Autoscale profiles updated for latency instances.

anya: SRE: dashboards added: gen.latency.{p50,p95}, streaming.sessions, toolcall.err_rate. Alerts: p95 > 600ms OR toolcall.err_rate > 0.6% -> page oncall. Synthetic streaming checks every 60s.

marta: Docs: migration guide + SDK streaming examples in PR, will post preview link once CI passes.

sam: Legal: tool-calling requires customer disclosure of external tool scopes; privacy policy updated and consent flow added to console.

kevin: No auth change. New optional params: `model_variant`, `streaming:true`, `allow_tool_calls:true`. Example curl:
```\ncurl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v3/gen \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-mosaic-latency-1","streaming":true,"input":"Summarize the test notes"}'\n```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary started for gen-pool-latency at 1845001300

olivia: Migration notes: customers get console banners and emails. Recommend mosaic-lite-quant as cost fallback. Rollback plan: flip routing feature-flag -> target v2 group, <30m to full rollback. Ping #eng-oncall and tag @anya for anomalies. :rocket:
